rules.outline: every opaque pixel 4-adjacent to transparency (or the canvas edge) is #241C32
rules.lighting: non-outline pixels on the top-left side brighter than the bottom-right side
rules.grounding: lowest opaque row = 30, one continuous run of outline pixels, nothing below
rules.overlap_unit: display pixels (native x3) of decor opacity intersecting each element's union of all reachable pixels
rules.stock_bottles: must be zero except the listed leaf-brooch slot exception (decor is drawn behind stock bottles)
rules.draw_order: counter prop right after counter; souvenir at the aging-cask slot before stock bottles

exceptions.why: 26 px diagonal sprite; between the cauldron HUD panel corner (x<73 from row 22) and the shelf-wrap stock path (x>=97 at rows 0-44) only 24 columns are free, so no position clears both. The HUD is kept at 0; the leaf's top-right tip lies on the wrap path, where the moving bottle is drawn in front of it.

space_analysis.note: native coordinates; zero = no pixel shared with keeper, customers, sale/stock bottles, HUD or furniture
